services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: St. Petersburg's annual Arbor Day Celebration, the Green Thumb Festival, brings together plant and flower lovers, as well as, individuals and families looking for a fun weekend activity. With more than 120 garden, plant and flower vendors and exhibitors, the annual event brings the community together for a weekend of fun.PARKING & SHUTTLE INFORMATIONParking is available at Azalea Middle School, Azalea Youth Soccer League, and behind Walter Fuller Recreation Center. Handicap parking is located at the Walter Fuller Recreation Center's main parking lot and the Walter Fuller Pool parking lot.Shuttle Stops: #1 - Azalea Middle School#2 - Azalea Youth Soccer League#3 - Walter Fuller PoolPLANT PICK

services.name: Pool Rentals
services.desc: Pools are available to rent during times when they are not scheduled for program or community service use. Facilities may be rented for a minimum of two hours and a maximum of four hours. To reserve a pool for a swim meet or other large event, please complete a Facility Use Application.Facility Use Application Payment is due at the time of reservation. Payment may be made by cash, check (made payable to City of St. Petersburg), or credit
